name: velo
description: Velo V2 — two modes: Plan creates a persisted, versioned plan under .velo/ with explicit approval; Run executes a frozen, approved plan milestone by milestone with checks, review, and local commits. Neither mode pushes, merges, or opens PRs.

interface.shortDescription: Approval-gated planning and frozen-plan execution for Codex (Velo V2 — Plan and Run)
interface.longDescription: Velo V2 — two modes: Plan creates a persisted, versioned plan under .velo/ with explicit approval; Run executes a frozen, approved plan milestone by milestone with checks, review, and local commits. Neither mode pushes, merges, or opens PRs.
defaultPrompt: Plan a feature into a saved, versioned plan under .velo/
Revise a saved plan and approve it to freeze the version
Run an approved plan milestone by milestone with local commits
